name: score-drop
title: Score drop
description: A card with a question, a tick ruler with a needle and a big score whose digits drop in one by one with a springy bounce; in dark a light in the score’s colour rises from the bottom as the score grows. Read-only, or a slider you can drag or key.

props.name: value
props.description: The score. With `onValueChange` it is controlled; with `interactive` alone it is only the starting value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value when a key or a drag changes it. Passing it makes the card interactive.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Turn the ruler into a slider you can drag or key. Default: true when `onValueChange` is set.

props.name: title
props.description: The question or title at the top. Wrap words in `` to set them in full ink: `How calm was it?`

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name, when the title is not plain enough to read out. Default: the title's text.

props.name: caption
props.description: A small line under the ruler, such as "out of 100".

props.name: min
props.description: The value at the left end of the ruler. Default 0.

props.name: max
props.description: The value at the right end of the ruler. Default 100.

props.name: step
props.description: How far one arrow key or one tick of a drag moves the value. Default 1.

props.name: glow
props.description: Any CSS colour for the light that rises in dark mode and the needle's tip. Default `var(--primary)`.

props.name: ends
props.description: The labels under the two ends of the ruler. Default `min` and `max`; false hides them.

props.name: valueText
props.description: The value as words for screen readers. Default `${value} out of ${max}`.

a11y.text: When it has onValueChange or interactive it is one Tab stop. ArrowRight and ArrowUp add a step, ArrowLeft and ArrowDown remove one, Page Up and Page Down move by ten steps, Home and End go to the ends. Dragging along the ruler sets the value.

Read-only it is a meter; interactive it is a slider. It is named by the title (or label), described by the caption, and carries aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext (from valueText, default "58 out of 100"). The big digits, the ruler, the needle and the end labels are aria-hidden, so the score is read once.

Under reduced motion it shows the final state at once: no drop, no needle swing, no rising light and no tick stagger. Otherwise the digits drop in when the card scrolls into view and when the value changes; changes made by key or drag use a short, calm swap instead of the full drop.
The rising light is dark mode only; light mode is a plain card. In forced colors mode the frame becomes a real border. The focus ring is a real outline around the ruler and number.
